title: 第24章 连滚带爬，狼狈躲闪
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
沈千尘嘴角抽动，不知道是想笑还是什么。

    “听说你的封印术学得一塌糊涂。”他换了话题，语气直接得近乎冒犯，“既然如此，何必又浪费时间来参加选拔赛呢？就算进去了月影回廊，你也不一定学得会。”

    安怜皱眉，心里涌起一股怒气。

    这话说得太难听了。

    不是因为她玻璃心，而是沈千尘的语气太轻描淡写了，好像她来参加选拔赛是一件很可笑的事情，好像她的努力和坚持在他眼里一文不值。

    安怜深吸一口气，把涌上来的怒气压下去。

    她知道自己打不过沈千尘，但她不想输了气势。

    “废话少说。”安怜朝着沈千尘的方向，坚定道：“要战就战。”

    沈千尘眸中掠过一丝意外。

    他以为安怜会解释，会争辩，会说一些“我会努力的”“我能学会的”之类的话。

    但她没有。

    沈千尘嘴角扬起一个明显的弧度，从魔法储物戒中取出一根法杖。

    法杖通体银白色，杖身刻满了复杂的魔法纹路，顶端镶嵌着一颗拳头大的月白色宝石，散发着柔和的光芒。

    这是他第一次在比赛中这么早亮出法杖。

    安怜感知到了那根法杖的存在，杖身上的魔力波动很强，强到她的感知触角被弹得远远的。

    她不敢再分心，把所有的注意力都收了回来，集中在自己的魔力调动上。

    她没有法杖。

    不是买不起，是她不习惯用法杖。

    她的治愈和感知都是通过双手直接释放魔力的，用法杖反而觉得不顺手。

    “这才像样。”沈千尘说，法杖在手中转了一圈，在身侧站定。

    “来吧，让我看看，一个封印术倒数第一的光月觉醒者，到底能打几分。”

    话音落下，沈千尘身上的魔力波动骤然暴涨，铺天盖地的压迫感朝着安怜袭来。

    强。

    太强了。

    S级和SS级的差距，比她想象的要大得多。

    不止是魔力值的差距，更是质的不同。
content_en:
The corners of Shen Qianchen's mouth twitched, not sure if he wanted to laugh or something.

    "I heard that you are terrible at learning the sealing technique." He changed the topic, his tone was so direct that it was almost offensive, "In that case, why waste time participating in the trial? Even if you enter the Moon Shadow Corridor, you may not be able to learn it."

    An Lian frowned, anger welling up in her heart.

    This is too ugly to say.

    It wasn't because she had a glassy heart, but Shen Qianchen's tone was too understated, as if it was ridiculous for her to participate in the trials, as if her efforts and persistence were worthless in his eyes.

    An Lian took a deep breath to suppress the rising anger.

    She knew she couldn't beat Shen Qianchen, but she didn't want to lose her momentum.

    "Stop talking nonsense." An Lian said firmly in the direction of Shen Qianchen: "If you want to fight, then fight."

    A hint of surprise flashed in Shen Qianchen's eyes.

    He thought An Lian would explain, argue, and say things like "I will work hard" and "I can learn it."

    But she didn't.

    The corner of Shen Qianchen's mouth raised an obvious arc, and he took out a staff from the magic storage ring.

    The staff is silver-white in color, its body is engraved with complex magic lines, and the top is inlaid with a fist-sized moon-white gemstone, emitting a soft light.

    This is the first time he has shown his staff so early in the game.

    An Lian sensed the existence of the staff. The magic power on the staff fluctuated so strongly that her sensing tentacles were bounced far away.

    She didn't dare to be distracted anymore and took all her attention back, focusing on mobilizing her magic power.

    She doesn't have a staff.

    It's not that she can't afford it, it's that she's not used to using a staff.

    Her healing and perception are all done by releasing magic power directly through her hands, but it feels awkward to use the staff.

    "This is decent." Shen Qianchen said, turning the staff in a circle in his hand and standing next to him.

    "Come on, let me see how much a Light and Moon Awakener who ranks last in sealing skills can score."

    As soon as he finished speaking, the magic power in Shen Qianchen's body suddenly surged, and an overwhelming sense of oppression hit An Lian.

    powerful.

    Too strong.

    The gap between S-class and SS-class was much wider than she imagined.

    It's not just a difference in magic power, it's also a qualitative difference.
